newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - APL Ltd estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - APL Ltd estimates cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Friday it reduced its estimate for APL Ltd's earnings in the first quarter to nil from $0.15 a share and its estimate for fiscal 1997 to $2.50 from $2.70.
-- Gruntal said holding company revenues are probably off pace and no imminent improvement in ocean-going revenue yield is expected.

-- Those conditions could cause APL to post a loss because of Pacific Basin oversupply and "panic industry pricing" in anticipation of maritime deregulation of trade into and out of the United States, Gruntal said.
-- APL is the parent of the ocean freight shipping company American President Lines.
-- Its shares were trading up 7/8 Friday at 22-1/2.
